card.name: Words leading into 'under supervision' phrases
card.fires_on: Small words right after 'under' or just before 'under the direction/supervision of', such as 'the', 'medical', 'unless', 'only', in use-only-with-a-physician statements.

modes.label: After 'under'
modes.description: The word following 'under' that leads into supervision or direction wording.

modes.label: Before an implied 'under'
modes.description: Linking words in instructions that should be done as directed or under a physician's care.
modes.example: Pediatric Patients under 4 years of age: Use<< only>> as directed by physician.

card.plain: It fires on the small words inside phrases like 'use only under medical supervision' just before the word supervision appears.
